dedupe_keys.name: bedes building energy data exchange specification

description: BEDES, the Building Energy Data Exchange Specification, is a dictionary of terms and definitions for building characteristics, efficiency measures and energy use, hosted by the Building and Industrial Energy Systems Division at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. It is meant as the basis for consistent transformation of data between tools that support energy investment decisions, performance tracking and efficiency programmes, and it draws its terms from many existing sources. A web-based BEDES Mapping Manager lets users explore the dictionary, combine terms into composite terms and map application-specific terms to them; compliance is offered at two levels, mapping and exchange, the second adding an electronic exchange schema. Coverage: US building energy data practice, usable anywhere. Access: the dictionary and Mapping Manager on the LBNL site. Licence: not stated on the page read; free to use. Caveats: BEDES defines terms, not a file format, so exchange depends on schemas that adopt it. Simulation uses are harmonising building characteristics and energy data from different sources before they feed stock and benchmarking models. Related records: BuildingSync and the SEED Platform.
